description: Canonical license verification for all provenance-blocked records, using only atlas_constants license utilities.

canonical_license_utilities.is_denied_license: Returns True for NC/ND/proprietary/all-rights-reserved/unknown. CC-BY-SA and RAIL variants are NOT denied.
canonical_license_utilities.requires_attribution: Returns True for all CC variants except CC0, plus Apache-2.0/BSD/MIT/ODC-BY, plus any license containing 'attribution'.

verification_runtime: Verified via atlas_constants imported at runtime — confirmed outputs below.

is_denied_license('CC-BY-SA-4.0').explanation: CC-BY-SA-4.0 is NOT in the denied set (NC/ND/proprietary/all-rights-reserved/unknown). Share-alike imposes tracking obligations but does not block commercial use.

is_share_alike('CC-BY-SA-4.0').explanation: CC-BY-SA-4.0 contains 'cc-by-sa' pattern, confirming share-alike requirement.

requires_attribution('CC-BY-SA-4.0').explanation: CC-BY-SA-4.0 matches 'cc-by-sa-' pattern in attribution_required list.

verification_results.notes: License is commercially safe. Attribution and share-alike tracking documentation must be added before content revision proceeds.
